meta.title: Accessibility
meta.description: Our commitment to making the NestSelf website accessible to everyone.

hero.title: Accessibility statement
hero.lead: We want every person to be able to use this website comfortably, regardless of ability or the technology they use.

contactHint: Please contact us at {email} to report any accessibility issues.

sections.heading: Our target
paragraphs: We aim to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at Level AA.

sections.heading: What we test
paragraphs: We regularly test the following aspects of this website:
bullets: Full keyboard operation: every interactive element can be reached and activated with the keyboard alone
Screen reader labels: all images, controls and landmarks have meaningful text labels
Colour contrast: text and interactive elements meet the WCAG AA contrast ratio
Reflow at 320 px: the layout adapts without horizontal scrolling at narrow viewport widths
Reduced motion: animations are suppressed when you prefer reduced motion in your system settings
Text scaling: the layout works when browser text size is increased up to 200%

sections.heading: Known limitations
paragraphs: Third-party video players embedded in webinar pages may not meet the same accessibility standard as the rest of the site. We are working with our providers to improve this.

sections.heading: Report a problem
paragraphs: If you find an accessibility barrier on this website, please let us know. We take every report seriously and will work to resolve the issue.
